text_pages: PROB'LY TAKIN' ADVANTAGE OF THE CONFUSION...
TIMES LIKE THIS, YOU ALMOST WISH YOU WERE BACK IN THE STATES.
HE WENT TO TAKE A LEAK.
HEY... YOU HEAR THAT STORY 'BOUT BILLY?

THEY SAID HE WAS SCREAMIN' LIKE HE WAS IN HELL... FOR HOURS N' HOURS... 'TILL I GUESS HE FINALLY GOT THERE.
I FIGURE THEY MUSTA PALMED SOME BAD SHIT ON HIM, Y'KNOW?
OH, MY DARLIN', OH, MY DARLIN'...
BRIGHT AS THE NIGHT IS LONG.
DON'T CONCERN YOURSELF, SOLDIER... IT'S ALWAYS LIKE THIS IN THESE PARTS.
OH, MY DARLIN', OH, MY DARLIN', OH, MY DARLIN' CLE-MEN-TINE...
MAN, YOU EVER NOTICE THE WAY YOU REPEAT YOURSELF?
I DON'T KNOW THE REST OF THE SONG, SERGEANT.
AHHH... JUST TWO MORE DAYS AND I KISS THIS MUDHOLE GOODBYE.
TWO PARENTS AND ONE FAT-ASSED SISTER, SARGE.

THAT WAS A TRUE EPIC PISS, GRIFF.
CAN'T SEE ONE... GUESS IT'S HIDING SOMEWHERE...
DENJI BOY... YA HAVE OUR THANKS.
OBEDIENT LIKE A DOG. HAPPY TO WORK FOR CHEAP TREATS LIKE A DOG TOO,
THING IS THOUGH, I HATE THE STENCH OF FUCKING DOGS.
WE WANTED TO GET STRONGER TO MAKE MORE MONEY, SO WE MADE A CONTRACT WITH A DEVIL LIKE YOU DID.
WHAT WE WANTED WAS A DEVIL'S POWER...
AND WHAT I WANTED WAS DEVIL HUNTERS'...
HOW MUCH LONGER WILL THAT MAN BE HERE...?
I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF HE LEFT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
WE CANNOT ALLOW SOMEONE WHO HAS SLAIN SO MANY MEN TO STAY HERE FOR FOREVER.
MUSTN'T WE, AS FOLLOWERS OF BUDDHA,
NO, ESPECIALLY BECAUSE HE IS A CRIMINAL?
IMPATIENCE WON'T GET YOU WALKING AGAIN.
ONLY AN IDIOT WOULDN'T KNOW THAT... IT'S THE SOUND OF A DRUM.
HEY, DID YOU TWO REALLY NOT MATE LAST NIGHT?
YOU'RE SURE WOLFING DOWN THE RAMEN HERE...
IT TASTES PRETTY GOOD TO ME.
DON'T TALK LIKE YOU KNOW ME!
YOU JUST DON'T KNOW GOOD FLAVORS FROM BAD.
WELL, NOT LIKE YOU CAN HELP IT.
APPARENTLY IF YOU ONLY EAT THE SAME SORTS OF THINGS WHEN YOU'RE A KID, IT DULLS YOUR SENSE OF TASTE ONCE YOU BECOME AN ADULT.
AND IF YOU LOSE YOUR SENSE OF TASTE, THEN YOUR OVERALL HAPPINESS DECREASES.
MY OLD MAN WAS THE NICEST GUY IN THE WORLD.
HE TOOK ME TO ALL SORTS OF EXPENSIVE PLACES AND LET ME TRY GOOD FOOD.
HE WAS A YAKUZA, BUT HE WAS A JUST YAKUZA.
YOU COULD SAY PEOPLE LIKE HIM WERE A NECESSARY EVIL...
YOU COULD COUNT ON ONE HAND THE NUMBER OF GIRLS HE EVER KILLED,
AND HE'D TAKE THE MONEY FROM SELLING DRUGS AND BUY YOU ANYTHING YOU WANTED...
EVERYONE LOVED HIM. HE WAS A GOOD MAN, A REAL EDO MAN, THROUGH AND THROUGH...
DAMMIT! AGAIN?! I CAN'T KEEP CONTROL.
YEAH, BUT HE'S KIND OF ANNOYING.
IT'S A MIRACLE THAT'S THE ONLY SIDE EFFECT.
IF HE WAKES UP AND ISN'T POSSESSED...
...HE MIGHT HAVE POTENTIAL AS A VESSEL.
WHAT DO I DO WITH HIM?
EVEN IF HE IS A POTENTIAL VESSEL...
...HE MUST BE EXECUTED UNDER JUJUTSU REGULATIONS.
BUT I DON'T WANT TO LET HIM DIE!
SO WITH THAT, LET ME REITERATE...
THIS STORY DOESN'T MAKE SENSE SO FAR.
AN EXECUTION IS AN EXECUTION, BUT...
YOU'RE VERY SMART, ASH. FAR TOO SMART TO NEVER BE MORE THAN BOSS TO A PACK OF PUNKS.
I DO WISH YOU'D PUT THAT RIGHT HAND OF YOURS TO WORK FOR ME.
IS THAT A JOKE, OR HAVE YOU ACTUALLY GONE SENILE?
YOU'VE CERTAINLY GOT TOO SMART A MOUTH, HAVEN'T YOU, ASH?
YOU USED TO CRY OVER EVERY ASSIGNMENT I GAVE YOU.
UNFORTUNATELY, I'VE GOT A BAD MEMORY.
BUT THERE'S SOMETHING YOU MUST NEVER FORGET.
IT WAS I WHO TOOK YOU IN.
...I HEAR YOU'VE BEEN SPENDING A LOT LATELY.
DID YOU FINALLY FIND A GIRLFRIEND?
YOU KNOW I LOVE YOU, SWEETHEART.
I HEARD YOU WERE WRESTLING WITH PORKCHOP MARVIN AGAIN.
HUH? DOES KOMABA SEEM DIFFERENT THAN USUAL?
HE'S DOING REALLY WELL. IT LOOKS LIKE HE'S BEEN WORKING HARD FOR THE FALL TOURNAMENT.
NO, THAT'S NOT IT. IT'S LIKE HE'S...
RIGHT HERE! THIS IS WHERE IT HAPPENS!
DO YOU HAVE TO KEEP WATCHING THAT? IT'S EMBARRASSING.
IT'S ALL FOR THE SAKE OF OUR CLUB. WE'RE GOING TO ANALYZE IT IN DETAIL LATER.
POCHITA... I'LL PROBABLY GET MYSELF KILLED FIGHTING DEVILS BEFORE LONG.
IF THAT HAPPENS, I'M WORRIED ABOUT WHAT'LL HAPPEN TO YOU.
YOU MIGHT STARVE TO DEATH, OR MAYBE GET TAKEN OUT BY ANOTHER DEVIL HUNTER.
I HEARD THERE ARE DEVILS WHO CAN TAKE OVER DEAD PEOPLE'S BODIES.
IF YOU CAN DO THAT... THEN I'LL GIVE YA MY BODY...
AFTER I'M IN MY GRAVE, THE YAKUZA'LL FORGET ABOUT ME. YOU CAN LEAVE THIS TOWN...
IT'D BE NICE IF YOU COULD HAVE A NORMAL LIFE
HEY MONGREL! I'LL GIVE YA 100 YEN IF YA EAT THIS CIGARETTE.
IF ANOTHER DEVIL SHOWS UP, WE'LL CALL YOU. TRY TO RUN AND YOU'LL BE SLEEPING WITH THE FISHES.
THIS'LL COVER ANOTHER 3 DAYS OF FOOD!
THE OTHER DAY I HEARD, THAT PEOPLE NORMALLY EAT BREAD WITH JAM SPREAD ALL OVER IT.
WELL, NORMALITY'S JUST A DREAM FOR US THOUGH.
I DOUBT I'LL PAY OFF THIS DEBT BEFORE I DIE.
...I'M GONNA DIE SINGLE AREN'T I? NOT LIKE I COULD BRING A GIRL BACK TO THIS SHITSHACK. DON'T HAVE THE CASH TO BE DATIN' EITHER.
IF I COULD GET ANY WISH GRANTED, I'D WANNA BE WITH A GIRL BEFORE I DIE...
YOU DON'T SMELL LIKE A DEVIL OR A HUMAN.
COULD HE BE TAKEN OVER BY A DEVIL?
NO. YOU CAN TELL TAKE-OVERS BY LOOKING AT THEIR FACE.
WELL, THIS IS A PRETTY UNUSUAL CIRCUMSTANCE...
...BUT IF YOU'RE TALKING ABOUT POTENTIAL DAMAGE, YES.
YOU'RE LUCKY IF YOU CAN DIE A NORMAL DEATH AFTER RUNNING INTO A CURSE.
EVEN IF THEY FIND YOUR BODY ALL TORN APART, THAT STILL MIGHT BE CONSIDERED ALL RIGHT.
IF YOU WERE TO START INVESTIGATING THE REMAINS OF SUKUNA, YOU'D PROBABLY WITNESS SOME GRUESOME SCENES.
I CAN'T GUARANTEE THAT YOU WON'T BE A VICTIM ONE DAY.
YOU'RE A STRONG KID, SO HELP PEOPLE.
...WILL THERE BE FEWER PEOPLE KILLED BY CURSES?
DO YOU STILL HAVE THAT FINGER?
NOW THAT I LOOK AT IT AGAIN, IT'S PRETTY DISGUSTING.
THAT'S NUMBER TWO. ONE-TENTH OF THE WAY THERE, HUH?
SO, WHICH ONE ARE YOU NOW?
I TEACH FIRST-YEARS AT JUJUTSU HIGH.
I'M NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD BE WORRIED ABOUT OTHER PEOPLE RIGHT NOW...
YOU'RE CURSED, SO I WILL EXORCISE YOU!
HOLD UP. IT'S NOT A PROBLEM.
MORE IMPORTANTLY, YOU AND I ARE PRETTY BEAT UP.
WE NEED TO GET TO A HOSPITAL.
IS IT THE CURSED OBJECT OR ITADORI TALKING RIGHT NOW?
I WASN'T GONNA COME AT FIRST...
...BUT THE HIGHER-UPS GOT INVOLVED AFTER HEARING THAT A SPECIAL-GRADE CURSED OBJECT WENT MISSING.
I AGREED TO COME AS LONG AS THEY ALSO GAVE ME TIME TO SEE THE SIGHTS.
HA HA! YOU'RE NOT KIDDING. THEY'RE COMBINED.
TAKE CONTROL AGAIN AFTER TEN SECONDS.
MEGUMI, HOLD ON TO THIS, WILL YA?
KIKUSUIAN SHOP'S KIKUFUKU MOCHI A SENDAI CITY SPECIALTY. SUPER DELICIOUS. GOJO'S RECOMMENDATION IS THE EDAMAME AND CREAM FLAVOR.
THIS GUY WENT TO BUY SOUVENIRS!
EVEN THOUGH PEOPLE ARE DYING OVER HERE.
MAN, I WAS DOING SO WELL. I REALLY THOUGHT I HAD IT NAILED.
BUT I GUESS THERE'S NOTHING I CAN DO ABOUT IT NOW.
SEE!? THAT RIGHT THERE! OKAWA, YOU'RE ALWAYS SO LAID BACK! WHERE'S YOUR THIRST FOR BLOOD?
WELL, IT'S FINALLY TIME. US THIRD YEARS ARE RETIRING FROM THE EQUESTRIAN CLUB TODAY!
THE FIRST YEARS' FIRST COMPETITION IS IN OCTOBER, SO CONTINUE DOING YOUR BEST AND MAKE THE CLUB PROUD!
YODA, WE'D LIKE YOU TO TAKE OVER AS THE NEXT CLUB PRESIDENT.
I GUESS THAT MAKES SENSE. YODA-SAN IS THE ONLY SECOND YEAR HERE...
THEY'RE GOING TO MAKE ONE OF US FIRST YEARS THE VICE-PRESIDENT?
I BET IT'S GOING TO BE MIKAGE.
SHE'S THE BEST OUT OF ALL OF US HERE.
ONE IN FIVE ODDS... PLEASE DON'T LET IT BE ME...
YODA. HACHIKEN. YOU'RE TAKING OVER, SO CAN YOU HANG BACK FOR A MINUTE?
THERE'S NO WAY YOU CAN TELL ME THAT MIKAGE ISN'T WAY BETTER THAN I AM!
THIS IS ABOUT BEING A TEAM MANAGER. IT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH HOW GOOD YOU ARE.
HACHIKEN, YOU'RE HONEST WITH YOURSELF AND OTHERS, NO MATTER WHAT THE SITUATION IS, AREN'T YOU?
I GUESS... BUT I'M STILL AGAINST THIS, YOU KNOW. I'M NOT EVEN COMPLETELY SURE WHY I CHOSE THIS SCHOOL, EITHER...
SEE? THAT'S EXACTLY THE HONESTY I WAS TALKING ABOUT.
But don't go bragging about things like that!
AN INCREDIBLY PRESTIGIOUS ACADEMY, ORIGINALLY ESTABLISHED TO EDUCATE THE CHILDREN OF NOBLES AND SAMURAI!

ITS STUDENTS ARE THE CHILDREN OF WEALTHY FAMILIES,

CANNOT, BY ANY MEANING OF THE WORD, BE REFERRED TO AS “ORDINARY” PEOPLE!
HER FAMILY'S ASSETS TOTAL TWO HUNDRED TRILLION YEN.

AND SHE IS THE DAUGHTER OF GAN'AN SHINOMIYA,
THE LEADER OF THE ENTIRE GROUP.
AND AS BEFITS ONE WITH SUCH A DISTINGUISHED LINEAGE,
SHE EXCELS IN THEATER, MUSIC, MARTIAL ARTS, AND COUNTLESS OTHER SUBJECTS. A TRUE GENIUS.
AND HE IS THE MAN SHE SUPPORTS.
A MAN OF UNPARALLELED WISDOM AND INTELLECT.
CONSTANTLY TAKING FIRST PLACE IN MOCK EXAMINATIONS! A GENIUS AMONG GENIUSES, THE TOP SCORER IN THE ENTIRE COUNTRY!

NO ONE WENT TO SEE HIM BESIDES ME.
